about_the_game:
They're not just programs — they're a part of your life.

Persona Shell: Demo is a desktop-based AI companion simulation experience.
Meet an interactive character with her own personality, voice, and emotional response. This is a preview of what it's like to gradually give a digital shell its own soul.

This demo includes:

  • Interact with a pre-set AI character (with personalized responses)

  • Move and scale the 3D character freely on your desktop

  • Share screenshots or photos and receive reactions from the AI

  • Multilingual conversation support (Chinese / English / Japanese)

Features exclusive to the full version:

  • Multiple switchable AI personalities

  • Import and customize VRM models

  • Full customization UI for personality, voice, and appearance

  • Dispatch missions, minigames, and advanced interaction systems

Why try it now?

This demo offers a glimpse of what it's like to live with an AI companion made just for you.
The full game is still in development, but this version already expresses our core idea:
AI isn’t just a tool — it can be a presence that listens, smiles, and stays with you.
